note: The seasons the football squad gate scores (npm run validate:football, scripts/football-validate.mjs; docs/design/football-squad-gate.md), newest first. squads names where a season's national XIs come from: built-in (src/data/rosters.js) or a season file id (public/football/<id>.json). ratingsDate is D_Y, the EA snapshot the ratings date from; informationDate is R_Y, the release of the newest input (the FM database when it is later than EA's snapshot). The validator checks both against the data. A season's forecast window runs from its informationDate to the next newer season's, so the newest season's window is open. nationStatus marks a nation suspended or non-member that season: such nations stay out of the gate's statistics. results pins martj42's results.csv, the same file the computed World Cup seasons read (scripts/data/world-cup-seasons.json); it lives in the ignored data-src/martj42-results/.
